rules: COMPLETION-LEDGER-001 remains immutable historical/boundary evidence and must be consulted for exact prior packet, phase, subject and subsystem closure details.
A completed packet, phase, branch, hosted qualification, A-01 receipt, subsystem or integration slice does not by itself make its owning system complete.
SYSTEM-COMPLETION-STATUS-001 is authoritative for current whole-system completion standing.
PROSE is the only system currently complete.
SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain incomplete and active until explicit product-level completion authority changes their standing.
Book-Prose integration work is BOOK work around the already-complete PROSE child and does not reopen Prose feature completion absent a demonstrated defect or explicit user direction.
Historical completion evidence never transfers PASS across a changed SHA, changed integration subject, changed ownership boundary, or different qualification class.
